title: Spec context
description: One repository's spec context file (<work>/spec-<slug>.context.json), handed to its spec authors, its spec reviewer and its task decomposer as `repository context`. The step `spec_authoring.context` (orchestrator/flows/spec_authoring.py) writes it and validates it against this file. It holds facts and pointers only: what the architecture says about the Story's stacks is read from the matrix by the commands each member names, and from the architecture document headings `documents` names, never copied here.

slug.description: The repository's slug, as the work files name it.

frontend.description: Whether the repository is a frontend repository, whose UI items get design sources.

items.description: What this repository's Story builds: the span's items placed in this repository (target-report.schema.json, DeltaItem, with the repository's slug). An event item carries the event's description, its trigger and its producers (`publishedBy`).

stacks.description: Each stack the Story builds in, with the matrix ids of the entries the Story builds in it. `atw-matrix story-scope --stack <stack> --ids <entries>` prints the documents and headings that describe the stack and each entry, the constraints that bind them and the shared capabilities they must use; `atw-matrix uses --ids <entries>` prints the shared capabilities alone, each with what it provides and what its consumers must do.

documents.description: The architecture documents (arc42 and the detailed architecture) the story scopes of `stacks` name, each with its id, its file and the headings to read (none when a scope names the document as a whole). Read these headings and only these; cite a document by the path and heading given here.

dependsOn.description: Each dependency relationship from something the Story builds to something it does not build: context, never work.

prd.description: The PRD's path. The TRD states every obligation with its PRD heading as its source; open the PRD only to read a heading a TRD requirement cites, when the requirement's text does not settle a detail.

architectureResult.description: The solutions architect's result (architecture-result.schema.json). Its `facts` name the home document and heading of each design fact the architecture decided, in arc42 or in the detailed architecture under `detailed/`; the spec carries that design and decides none of it.

designSystem.description: The dispatch's design system facts (the driver surface's `designSystem` argument); empty when the dispatch gives none.

StackEntries.description: One stack and the matrix ids of the entries a Story builds in it.

DependsOn.description: One dependency of something a Story builds on something it does not build. `side` is the side that states the relationship: one with `side: repository` is a hint read from code, never an architecture fact. `stack` and `repository` are the far end's; `builtBy` is the storyKey of another Story of this Epic whose items include `to`, or null.
